$why: The ROADMAP's bit-identical bar demands zero quarantined fields. A field a suite sets aside is
lifted only by a fix in the port, or written down here with the proof that the reference
itself does not reproduce it, or with the decision that keeps it. tools/reports/generate.py
renders each entry into docs/VALIDATION.md, links it from the tools it names, and stops
reporting a compare rule as quarantined once an entry for that tool covers it. An entry whose
rule no suite of its tools declares any more is refused, so a lifted quarantine cannot leave

limits.title: The callers' debug outputs print System.identityHashCode
limits.verdict: bio-identical in the debug outputs of suite `hc-debug-outputs`; no suite of the three tools sets aside anything else
proof: Vertex ids and labels in the dot files, junction-tree node names and the genotyper debug's
`double[]` renderings are `System.identityHashCode`, and the files holding junction trees
print them from identity-keyed `HashMap`s, so in an order those hashes decide. Measured
2026-11-19: the suite's dump ran twice in a row in `gatk-rs-oracle:4.7.0.0` on one arm64 Mac under emulation
(`python3 tools/conformance/run_suite.py --suites hc-debug-outputs`, twice). The two dumps
and the CI golden, three runs of the reference on the same input, differ pairwise on 129 of
214 rows; with `mask_identity_hashes` alone on 3 of them, the junction-tree files; with both
rules on none. Nothing outside those shapes moves, and those shapes move in every run: no
port can be byte-identical to a reference that is not byte-identical to itself.

limits.title: Java's HDF5 library stamps object headers with the clock
limits.verdict: bio-identical in the 48 bytes of seconds; every other byte of the annotations, the models' score files and the VCF is compared
proof: The masked file is the annotations ExtractVariantAnnotations writes, which the port reads
as training input and never writes in this suite. The committed golden is its own proof:
its two passes, `default` and `seven`, run the same ExtractVariantAnnotations command on the
same fixture in the same container, and their `extract.annot.hdf5` are 175,040 bytes each
and differ in 12 bytes, every one inside one of the twelve Object Modification Time messages,
which read 2026-11-05T07:34:31 and 07:34:42 UTC. The same clock is why the dump compares the
doubles of `score.scores.hdf5` rather than its bytes, and the scorer pickle is hashed without
the name of the temporary script it ran from, random in every run (`tools/python-tools/dump_vets.py`).

limits.title: NVScoreVariants' bits past the dense layers
limits.verdict: byte-identical in what the tool writes (the VCF and its `%.3f` scores); the intermediate floats are not claimed
proof: MKL's `SGEMM` sums the dense layers in an order set by the thread count and the batch size,
so the reference's own floats move with them: against one thread at batch 64, four threads
differ on 2047 of 2840 dense_2.0 values and on 20 of 71 scores by up to 5 ulp, one thread at
batch 1 on 43 of 71 scores. Its VCF and score file are identical at 1, 2, 4 and 16 threads,
and its score file at batch sizes 1, 7 and 64. `docs/nvscorevariants.md`, suite `nvscorevariants`.

limits.title: CreateReadCountPanelOfNormals' eigensample count is a solver's rank
limits.verdict: bio-identical in the panel's eigensamples: suites hold the cap the rank is taken under, whether the basis is empty, and at `local[1]` the count and the values above the noise
proof: The count is the number of singular values over rCond 1e-9, decided on values that are
rounding noise on a rank-deficient panel, in the order Spark folds the Gramian. The same
fixture answered 8, 6 and 7 eigensamples on two CI runs and a laptop with one image; twelve
runs at `local[4]` gave eleven sets of bits and ranks 6 and 7; two identical runs in one
container wrote HDF5 panels differing in 268 bytes (#1270). `docs/a-rank-is-not-a-byte.md`,
`docs/spark-parallel.md`, suites `create-read-count-panel-of-normals`,
`create-read-count-panel-rank` and `create-read-count-panel-arpack`.

limits.title: AnalyzeSaturationMutagenesis --write-rejected-reads
limits.verdict: held out of the covering array at false; the other outputs are compared byte for byte
proof: GATK writes BAMs asynchronously, and a read rejected before its report exists is added to
the rejected BAM twice, once tagged `XX:unmapped` and again, after `processReport` retags the
same object `XX:lowQ`. Whether the first copy was encoded before the retag depends on the
writer thread: 4 of 18 reference runs under load kept `XX:unmapped` on `dup1` and `qc1`
(`tools/coverage/fixtures.json`).

limits.title: BwaMemIndexImageCreator writes heap addresses
limits.verdict: byte-identical outside the address fields and padding, which the covering array zeroes from the image's layout; the golden holds the size and the instability
proof: BWA's serialiser writes in-process pointers through JNI, which address-space layout
randomisation moves on every run: one reference built twice in one process gives two images
of the same length differing in nine bytes. `docs/pointers-that-reach-the-output.md`.

limits.title: GenomicsDBImport names fragments by UUID, thread and clock
limits.verdict: byte-identical outside the fragment and metadata names, the header's `Date` and the schema's absolute path, which the dump numbers or masks
proof: Two reference runs on the same input wrote 134 files of which 133 are identical; what
differs is the fragment and `genomicsdb_meta` file names (a UUID, a thread id and the wall
clock), `Date` in `vcfheader.vcf` and the absolute path in `__array_schema.tdb` (suite
`genomicsdb-import`, #1400).

limits.title: DecimalFormat above 2^53 (68 values)
limits.verdict: a decision, not an instability: the reference is stable here, and the port follows the specification where Java 17 departs from it
proof: Above 2^53 Java 17's pre-Schubfach converter stops producing the shortest decimal form, and
`DecimalFormat` keeps that converter until JDK 26, so 68 renderings across the two
repositories' corpora differ. Below 2^53 nothing differs on 903,121 measured values. An oracle
on JDK 26 takes the 68 to 0 for one golden regenerated in each repository, against a runtime
GATK does not ship on: decision #115, open. The ROADMAP measures nothing a gatk-rs tool prints
within eleven orders of magnitude of 2^53. `docs/licence-compatibility-risk.md`.
